description.en: Verified, pinned community packages for DSH Desktop. dsh-context-memory 1.2.0 is blocked: user-isolation acceptance failed; this release does not offer new activation. Other catalog entries without confirmed versions are not listed as installable packages.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 已核验版本的社区插件。dsh-context-memory 1.2.0 用户隔离验收未通过，本版暂不提供新启用。其他尚无已核验版本的目录条目不列入可安装清单。

description.en: A one-stop DeepSeek Harness context insight and visualization plugin: a Context dashboard and browser plus /context command that reveal composition, history evolution, compaction/prune events, and token cost per message and image.
description.zh: 一站式 DeepSeek Harness 上下文洞察与可视化插件：Context 面板与浏览器加 /context 命令，透视上下文构成、历史演进与压缩/剪枝等事件，并展示消息与图片的 token 占用。

description.en: Optional prompt customization, skill collections and MCP Server configuration for DeepSeek Harness. Existing P1 preferences remain available.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的三合一能力台：提示词定制、技能集合管理与 MCP Server 接入。按需启用，保留现有 P1 偏好。

description.en: Optional messaging channels for DeepSeek Harness. Install and connect a Feishu bot when needed. Keep existing QQ bots managed by Desktop.
description.zh: 按需接入消息渠道，首轮试用飞书机器人。安装后需自行绑定飞书账号，已有 QQ 机器人继续在桌面版管理。
